**NORTH-WEST MOUNTED POLICE**
**Black Pine Detachment – District of Saskatchewan, North-West Territories**

# MISSING PERSON INVESTIGATION - PROGRESS REPORT – THREE MONTHS

**Case No.:** 01-2710-00
**Date:** 27 October 1901

**Location:** Black Pine Former Silver Mine (B Shaft)

---

### Persons Involved

**Andrew John Spencer DOB 12 AUG 1888 (12)**
Recovered alive. Died from injuries sustained.

**Askew Arnold Spencer DOB 06 NOV 1891 (9) Known as 'Arnie'**
Missing. Presumed DEAD.

---

### Summary

Both boys entered the abandoned B Shaft of the Black Pine Former Silver Mine during the afternoon of 27 July 1901.

Andrew John Spencer later returned to Spencer Farm, Black Pine, suffering severe injuries according to witness statements. He later died at the residence from suspected blood loss and shock, confirmed by the local Coroner on 28 July.

The search for Askew Arnold Spencer continues.

---

### Evidence Recovered at initial sweep of cave

• White cotton handkerchief
• Wooden varnished lunchbox
• 40 ft hemp rope
• Unlit straw torch saturated with fuel oil

---

**Case Status** OPEN – MISSING PERSON PRESUMED DEAD

**Remarks** 

No explanation has been established for the circumstances surrounding Andrew John Spencer's injuries.

A facsimile has just come through carrying a copy of a missing person report for an unsolved case back in 1901!

Reading it intrigues you and you decide to investigate.  You manage to find a photo online of the cave taken around the time of the tragedy described in this report.

---

**CASE FILE TRANSMISSION**

# WELCOME TO THE INVESTIGATION

---

You are now investigating the Arnie Spencer tragedy.

Before you do anything else, read through the background story sitting on the desk in front of you - it lays out everything known about the case so far.

Once you have read it, take a moment to get to grips with the different items and tools laid out on the desk. Each one will help you dig deeper as the investigation unfolds.

Good luck.

---
